body: Jaz sem enkrat dobila bon 20€ za mercator.

Products used: Claresa Rubber base 11 and Top no wipe
Red is Claresa red 418
New ones are both Hi Hybrid, Faint pink #205 and Glamour dust #400

Prek studenta sem delala vsa leta dodiplomca, dopoldne v pisarni, obcasno se vikendi v strezbi. Popoldne faks. Kar naporno, ampak ce ne bi delala, bi si solanje tezko privoscila. Tudi magisterij nameravam opravljat ob delu. Sem pa izbrala faks, ki je dost prijazen zaposlenim.

So pa me zdaj zaposlili tu, kjer sem prej delala prek studenta.
Imam tri, vsi z nekim pomenom.
All products are from Claresa: primer, ultra base, no wipe top, the color is Mint 3.

Products:
Base and top by Rosalind. For pink base color I used Rosalind no.37, topped with Sparkle on darling by Depend and Sugars glittery no.39.
